name: Sealed column hall
description: A solid stone hall with attached pilasters, a complete gabled roof and a shut double door. The narrow footing offers no courtyard or walk-through passage.

name: Octagonal reliquary
description: A compact eight-sided sanctuary with solid walls and a low faceted roof. A sealed portal and exterior rune identify the temple without exposing an interior.

name: Ribbed stone vault
description: An enclosed shrine beneath a broad barrel vault, with wall-bound buttresses and a closed stone door. The continuous roof and solid footprint read as a single blocked building.

name: Rune court
description: A stepped open sanctuary with a low stone boundary and a central altar. Closest to the current temple; the floor and runes stay visible at every heading.

name: Pillared cloister
description: Three sheltered sides frame an open ritual court. Native Temple columns and low stone roofs add a stronger silhouette while preserving a clear view of the altar.

name: Stepped sanctum
description: A compact shrine on two terraces, with an open front, corner columns and a shallow stone roof. Strongest landmark silhouette; toggle the roof to inspect its altar.

name: Copper courtyard block
description: A continuous U-shaped steampunk building forms the fort perimeter. Copper roofs, native facade bays and a central entry frame an exposed courtyard.

name: Palisade & gearhouse
description: The current fort idea rebuilt with continuous tile-textured timber panels and a central 3D gearhouse. Open yard, clear gate and the smallest perimeter silhouette.

name: Walled copper compound
description: A low masonry enclosure surrounds a broad steampunk hall and two supply sheds. More substantial than timber fencing while leaving the central building distinct.
